title: GN-I&E—Health-Provider – Consultant
description:
**I\&E Health Industry – Provider Front Office (S\&C GN)**
**Management Level**
 L7
   

  

**Location**
 TBU
   

  

**Recruiter Contact**
 TBU
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Health I\&E practice at Accenture is looking for experienced healthcare professionals to support and lead Hospital Front Office engagements across strategy, implementation, and consulting for health systems across EMEA, Americas, and APAC. You will work across the full engagement lifecycle, from strategy definition and requirements gathering, through solution design, implementation delivery, and post\-go\-live optimization \- spanning patient access and scheduling transformation, digital front door strategy, patient experience, care navigation, wellness management, @home care, and workforce strategy. Engagements range from business case development and BRD authoring to system implementation and go\-live support, shaping end\-to\-end transformation across consumer experience, clinical operations, and technology.
   

  

**Functional Capabilities**
* Experience delivering end\-to\-end implementations of patient access, scheduling, or care navigation solutions in healthcare settings
* Contact Center Operations \& Transformation \- redesigning contact center models through omnichannel routing, workforce optimization, and GenAI\-powered virtual agents, agent assist, and intelligent routing
* Growth Strategy \- patient acquisition, market positioning, access expansion, and ambulatory footprint strategy
* Vendor selection, IT strategy and digital health solution assessment for patient access platforms, scheduling tools, and care navigation technologies, telehealth, remote patient monitoring, and patient portal
* GenAI and AI\-powered solutions in patient access, scheduling optimization, and clinical decision support
* Requirements gathering and stakeholder workshop facilitation \- translating clinical and operational needs into structured functional requirements
* Business Requirements Document (BRD) authoring, including process flows, use cases, and functional specifications for front office technology solutions
* Fit\-gap analysis and solution configuration support for patient access platforms, or digital engagement tools
* User Acceptance Testing (UAT) planning, test script development, and defect triage for front office technology implementations
* Training material development and end\-user training delivery for clinical and administrative staff
* Go\-live readiness assessment and hyper care support for patient access and scheduling technology deployments


**Good To Have Skills**
* Supporting healthcare organizations on growth and market entry
* Exposure to value\-based care models and their impact on access and patient experience design
* Agile or hybrid delivery methodologies in healthcare technology programs


**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with delivery and leadership teams to develop and present actionable recommendations for client strategic decisions on front office transformation
* Contribute to and lead the design and delivery of patient access, scheduling transformation, and care navigation engagements spanning strategy through implementation across EMEA, Americas, and APAC markets
* Conduct requirements gathering workshops with clinical, operational, and IT stakeholders to define functional and technical needs for front office solutions
* Author and maintain BRDs, functional specifications, process flow documentation, and configuration workbooks for patient access and scheduling technology programs
* Lead fit\-gap analyses, solution design sessions, and configuration reviews for digital front door implementations
* Develop test plans, test scripts, and manage defect resolution cycles in coordination with client and vendor teams
* Design change management programs for clinical and administrative staff on front office tools and workflows
* Build effective working relationships with client stakeholders across operations, clinical leadership, and digital functions


**Professional Skills**
**Professional \& Technical Skills**
**Functional Skills**
* Strategic Thinking
* Executive Communication
* Stakeholder Management
* Leadership \& Team Mentoring
* Project \& Program Management
* Patient Access \& Scheduling Strategy
* Growth Strategy \& Market Expansion
* Digital Front Door \& Consumer Engagement
* GenAI \& Digital Health Solution Assessment
* Care Navigation \& Workforce Strategy
* Cost \& Productivity Reinvention
* Requirements Gathering \& BRD Authoring
* UAT Planning \& Go\-Live Support

title: Level 2 Product Support Engineer REQ_36
description:
**Senior Quality Assurance Engineer**
 3Pillar is an AI transformation partner on a mission to help enterprises build the AI\-native products and intelligent agents that will define the next era of business. With teams across North America, Europe, Latin America, and Asia, we work with the most ambitious companies in financial services, healthcare, media, and technology — helping them move faster, modernize boldly, and compete on their own terms. Our HelixAI platform and Helix Pods delivery model put our engineers at the center of real agentic transformation — doing work that is open, portable, and built to last. We are building the future of enterprise AI.
   

  

 Embark on a pivotal journey to the forefront of Quality Assurance with 3Pillar Global!
   

  

 Welcome to our team at 3Pillar Global, where we lead important projects that change technology and industries. We are committed to being the best, using the latest technologies to make a big difference in various areas. As a Technical Lead in QA Engineering, you will be in charge of our team, making sure our projects are of the highest quality and reliability. Your role is key in improving city living, creating new ways for companies to use media, and making healthcare better. Your leadership will help our solutions be the best they can be.
   

  

 This role is more than just testing—it's about leading the way in making sure our products are perfect and make a lasting difference. With your deep understanding of technology, attention to detail, and commitment to excellence, you will guide and inspire others, setting new standards for quality. You lead the journey in making our products stand out. If you want to make a big impact and lead our quality efforts, your journey starts here, at the heart of 3Pillar's product development.
   

  

**Desired Capabilities**
* Leadership skills
* Mentoring and coaching abilities
* Strategic thinking and decision\-making skills
* Project management skills
* Stakeholder management and collaboration skills
* Ability to motivate and inspire team members
* Continuous improvement mindset
* Strong technical skills
* Knowledge of testing tools and methodologies
* Quality assurance and process improvement expertise
* It's advantageous to possess a keen business acumen and grasp of industry trends and standards.


**Responsibilities**
* Operational Excellence in QA Strategy Implementation: Implement and refine quality assurance strategies as devised in collaboration with the Product Development Manager (PDM) for your engagement(s). Focus on translating strategic visions into actionable plans that enhance testing efficiency and product quality across projects.
* Test Management and Execution Leadership: Manage the design, development, and execution of comprehensive testing frameworks that align with the Architect's technology and quality standards. Ensure projects are executed with precision, adhering to established timelines and resource allocations.
* Automation Strategy Execution: Lead the practical application and optimization of automation frameworks in line with the Architect’s overarching technology roadmap. Drive the adoption of advanced automation tools and practices that enhance testing processes and product quality.
* Cross\-Functional Team Collaboration: Act as a pivotal liaison between the QA team and other departments, ensuring seamless integration of QA processes with development and product management workflows. Collaborate with the Architect to ensure QA strategies support organizational goals and product innovation.
* Quality Culture and Team Development: Foster a culture of quality and continuous improvement within the QA team, aligning with the Architect’s vision for excellence. Mentor team members, enhancing their skills and leadership capabilities to meet evolving QA challenges.
* Process Improvement and QA Innovation: Identify and lead initiatives to improve QA processes, tools, and methodologies under the guidance of the Architect. Encourage innovation within the team, staying informed of industry trends and technologies that can elevate quality assurance practices.
* Industry Trends and Best Practices: Maintain a deep understanding of current and emerging QA technologies and methodologies. Share insights with the team and the Architect, ensuring the QA strategy remains at the cutting edge and drives competitive advantage.
* Strategic Support in Project Planning: Provide expert QA guidance in project planning and execution, aligning quality assurance methods with project goals and the broader technological framework established by the Architect. Ensure quality is integrated at every stage of the product development lifecycle.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field; Master’s or advanced degree preferred. Equivalent practical experience considered.
* Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in the IT field, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of testing strategies, methodologies, and automation in complex software development environments.
* 4\+ years of leadership experience in QA roles, with a proven track record of managing high\-performing QA teams and leading large\-scale testing initiatives.
* Expertise in QA automation frameworks and tools (Playwright, Selenium, TestComplete or equivalent), with a strong command of programming languages relevant to automation (Python, Java, C\#).
* Comfortable with AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent).
* Advanced project management skills, with a history of successfully managing projects from conception to delivery, ensuring alignment with strategic business goals.
* Demonstrated excellence in stakeholder management and collaboration, with the ability to influence decisions and drive QA strategies across functions within 3Pillar and with external partners.
* Solid experience with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) practices and DevOps methodologies, enhancing QA processes and productivity.
* Strong business acumen, with an understanding of industry trends, standards, and the competitive landscape, leveraging this insight to inform strategic QA decisions.
* Exceptional problem\-solving skills, with a systematic approach to tackling complex issues and the initiative to continuously enhance technical and leadership skills.
* Highly developed communication skills, proficient in engaging with senior management, stakeholders, and external partners to advocate for quality assurance excellence and influence strategic directions.


**Desired**
* Professional QA certifications (ISTQB Advanced Level, CSTE) or certifications in project management (PMP, Agile/Scrum certifications).
* Deep understanding of and experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and testing in cloud\-native environments.
* Proven ability in strategic thinking and decision\-making, with a forward\-looking approach to QA leadership, ensuring alignment with emerging technologies and industry trends.
* Outstanding leadership and team development skills, capable of mentoring, coaching, and inspiring a diverse team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.
* Comprehensive knowledge of current and emerging testing tools, methodologies, and best practices, with the ability to implement these to drive efficiency and effectiveness in QA processes.


**What is it like working for 3Pillar Global?**
**At 3Pillar, We Offer a World Of Opportunity**
* Imagine a flexible work environment – whether it's the office, your home, or a blend of both. From interviews to onboarding, we embody a remote\-first approach.
* You will be part of a global team, learning from top talent around the world and across cultures, speaking English everyday. Our global workforce enables our team to leverage global resources to accomplish our work in efficient and effective teams.
* We’re big on your well\-being – as a company, we spend a whole trimester in our annual cycle focused on wellbeing. Whether it is taking advantage of fitness offerings, mental health plans (country\-dependent), or simply leveraging generous time off, we want all of our team members operating at their best.
* Our professional services model enables us to accelerate career growth and development opportunities \- across projects, offerings, and industries.
* We are an equal opportunity employer. It goes without saying that we live by values like Intrinsic Dignity and Open Collaboration to create cutting\-edge technology AND reinforce our commitment to diversity \- globally and locally.
* Join us and be a part of a global tech community! 🌍💼 Check out our Linkedin site and Careers page to learn more about what it’s like to be part of our \#oneteam!

title: Senior Agilist - Product Group (Banking Foundation)
description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Product Senior Agilist owns the delivery and transformation system for a Product Group, ensuring predictable execution across multiple Agile Teams, and manages the Team Agilists in the Product Group, ensuring consistent execution discipline, system transparency, and continuous advancement of Radiance maturity. This role ensures that flow, alignment, and continuous improvement are established at the Product Group level. Acting as the facilitator of cross\-team events and a coach for product, design and engineering leadership, the Product Agilist drives the product transformation, orchestrates planning and delivery across teams, resolves systemic impediments, leads risk management, and ensures that practices are consistent with organizational standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Establish and operate the Product Group planning and execution cadence, including PI Planning, Release Management, Work Intake governance, and Inspect \& Adapt.
* Lead transformation and execution of a Product (team of teams). Cultivate and lead high\-performing, cross\-functional teams by leveraging exceptional communication and employing advanced coaching and mentoring techniques
* Effectively leading global products involves managing relationships at an enterprise level, cultivating long\-term, mutually beneficial relationships to enhance the outcomes of products at scale
* Support alignment across multiple Agile Teams by making dependencies visible, escalating systemic impediments, manage cross\-team risks, and driving coordinated delivery.
* Partner with Product, Design and Engineering Managers to ensure clarity of priorities, effective planning, and risk mitigation.
* Serve as a member of the Product Group Leadership Team (PLT).
* Help the Product Group team integrate with the Portfolio and navigate complexity.
* Collaborate with Portfolio and Product Area Leadership Teams to drive Product and Portfolio success.
* Coach Product Group Managers in effective Agile road\-mapping and backlog management.
* Collaborate with other Product Group Agilists across the entire portfolio to ensure practices are consistent with organizational standards and framework.
* Lead and develop the Team Agilists within the Product Group, ensuring strong execution discipline, consistent Radiance practices, and continuous development of team\-level delivery leadership.
* Ensure transparent execution tracking across the Product Group, including readiness, delivery progress, predictability, risks, and impediments, enabling the Product Group Leadership Team to make timely decisions.Apply and improve organizational standards and identify opportunities for change.
* Coach the Product Leadership Team in Agile principles and flow\-based delivery.
* Actively participate in the Agilists Community of Practice (CoP) to share learnings and promote continuous improvement, leading areas of our practice transformation.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning within the organization to proactively build and develop its knowledge base
* Maintain transparent execution visibility for the Product Group Leadership Team through delivery metrics, risk tracking, and readiness signals.


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of experience in Agile leadership, with at least 1 year having responsibility over an entire team\-of\-teams, agile program or product.
* Proven success facilitating and aligning multiple teams around shared objectives and cadences.
* Mastery of several Agile product, process and technical practices (Scrum, Kanban, XP, Crystal, Amplio).
* Demonstrable experience with and operational knowledge of several team\-of\-teams Lean and Agile methods and scaling practices (Kanban, SAFe, LeSS, Nexus, ToC).
* Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve systemic impediments impacting multiple teams.
* Ability to clarify their product needs, challenges, and opportunities, articulate a transformation vision, and pursue it.
* Skilled in facilitation, servant leadership, and conflict resolution.
* Experience in product development (new product introduction and mature product sustaining).
* Experience working with Product Managers and Engineering Managers in a technology\-driven environment.
* Skilled in using Agile metrics to inform decision\-making and continuous improvement.
* Coached senior leaders and stakeholders (director level and above preferred)
* Led multi\-team change initiatives and coached other facilitators and change agents


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in fintech, SaaS, or other fast\-paced technology industries.
* Familiarity with lean portfolio management and product governance practices.


**Core Competencies**
* Facilitation at Scale – Brings together multiple teams and functions to align on objectives and outcomes.
* Servant Leadership – Builds trust, empowers others, and removes barriers to success.
* Coaching Mindset – Guides Team Agilists, Product Leaders, and Engineers in Agile practices.
* Systems Thinking – Recognizes interdependencies and works to optimize flow across teams.
* Continuous Improvement – Drives learning, adaptation, and the evolution of practices across the product to enhance value delivery and team maturity.


**Reporting \& Relationships**
* Reports to: Lead Agilist
* Collaborators: Product Manager, Engineering Manager(s), Team Agilists, Designers
* Peers: Other Product Agilists


**Statement to Third Party Agencies**
 To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.
